description: Homeserver connection settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.HomeserverConfig.

address.description: The URL of the homeserver's client-server API (e.g. http://synapse:8008).

domain.description: The server_name of the homeserver (e.g. example.com).

async_media.description: Does the homeserver support asynchronous media uploads (MSC2246)?

public_address.description: Public-facing base URL if the homeserver's API is behind a reverse proxy.

software.description: The type of homeserver software (standard, asmux, or hungry).

status_endpoint.description: URL to push bridge status updates to.

message_send_checkpoint_endpoint.description: URL to push message send checkpoints to.

websocket.description: Use websocket appservice transactions instead of HTTP.

websocket_proxy.description: HTTP proxy URL for the websocket connection.

ping_interval_seconds.description: Interval in seconds between websocket pings. 0 disables.
